title: Saving an answer on the waiting page gets a visible reply
why: Your gripe, Oct 26 (waiting page): "would also prefer if there was a way that submitting questions resulted in a reaction"; today you type "submitted" by hand.
note: Done, Oct 27: lane PR 662 landed in batch PR 667 (main 835cde5): a save on the waiting page sends a comment to Claude, which wakes each session watching the page. To turn it on, each live waiting page must be republished with the db and comments capabilities; that sits on c100's build lane. Port: yes, through the waiting-page skill.
